back_translation: The number of the Israelites will be like the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured or counted; and in the place where it was said to them, 'You are not My people,' they will be called 'sons of the living God.'
The people of Judah and the people of Israel will be gathered together; they will appoint for themselves one leader and will go up out of the land, for great will be the day of Jezreel.
Call your brothers 'Ammi' (My people), and call your sisters 'Ruhamah' (one shown compassion).
Rebuke your mother, rebuke her, for she is not My wife and I am not her husband; let her put away her adultery from her face and her unfaithfulness from between her breasts.
Otherwise I will strip her naked and expose her as on the day she was born; I will make her like a wilderness, turn her into a parched land, and make her die of thirst.
I will not have compassion on her children, because they are children of adultery.
For their mother has played the harlot; she who conceived them has acted shamefully, for she said, 'I will go after my lovers, who give me my food and water, my wool and linen, my oil and drink.'
Therefore, behold, I will hedge up her way with thorns and wall her in, so that she cannot find her paths.
She will chase her lovers but not catch them; she will seek them but not find them. Then she will say, 'I will return to my first husband, for I was better off then than now.'
She does not know that it was I who gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, I who multiplied her silver and gold, which they used to worship Baal.
Therefore I will take back My grain in its season and My new wine in its time; I will take away My wool and My linen, which I gave to cover her nakedness.
Now I will expose her lewdness before the eyes of her lovers, and no one will rescue her from My hand.
I will bring an end to all her mirth—her feasts, her New Moons, her Sabbaths, and all her appointed feasts.
I will destroy her vines and fig trees, of which she said, 'These are the wages my lovers gave me.' I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field will devour them.
I will punish her for the days she worshiped the Baals, when she burned incense to them, adorned herself with rings and jewelry, and went after her lovers, but forgot Me, declares the LORD.
Therefore, behold, I will allure her, lead her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.
There I will restore her vineyards to her, and make the Valley of Achor a door of hope. There she will respond as in the days of her youth, as in the day she came up out of the land of Egypt.
In that day, declares the LORD, you will call Me 'my husband,' and no longer call Me 'my master.'
For I will remove the names of the Baals from her mouth, and no one will invoke their names anymore.

In that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, the birds of the air, and the creatures that crawl on the ground; I will abolish bow, sword, and war from the land, and make them lie down in safety.
I will betroth you to Myself forever; I will betroth you in righteousness, justice, steadfast love, and compassion.
I will betroth you in faithfulness, and you will know the LORD.
In that day I will respond, declares the LORD; I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth.
The earth will respond to the grain, the new wine, and the oil, and they will respond to Jezreel.
I will sow her for Myself in the land; I will have compassion on Lo-ruhamah (No-compassion), and I will say to Lo-ammi (Not-My-people), 'You are My people,' and he will say, 'You are my God.'
